checks.explanation: Google's search market share has eroded somewhat by 2026 without triggering anything close to a 50% cut to Alphabet's market capitalization; Alphabet's stock has instead grown substantially.
Competitors like Perplexity have taken modest search share from Google without causing anything close to a 50% decline in Google's stock price.
Data licensing to AI model providers became a real incremental revenue stream for many content owners, with deals struck by Reddit, News Corp, and various publishers in subsequent years.
Reddit instead went public via IPO in 2024 and remains independent, while Stack Overflow was acquired by Prosus in 2025, so the prediction proved right for one platform and wrong for the other.
Industry practices for valuing and licensing AI training data became considerably clearer over the following year, with numerous publisher licensing deals and emerging norms established.
Teleperformance's market capitalization has remained in the multi-billion-euro range well above $1 billion despite AI-driven customer support disruption concerns.
AI customer-support systems did not reach handling roughly 98% of queries by the end of 2024.
AI tools have substantially lowered the cost for solo founders to reach product-market fit, broadly consistent with the prediction.
AI-powered voice agents in call centers, sounding increasingly human and often indistinguishable from human agents, expanded significantly through 2025-2026.
